item.title: Is 2 months a trend? Las Vegas home prices stabilizing in buyers' favor, LVR reports

item.title: Las Vegas doctor says new study having profound benefits for pregnant women
item.description: A blood test and a treatment regimen described as "very low risk, very low cost, but seemingly super effective" could reduce pre-term births in the U.S., according to a Las Vegas doctor.

item.title: Las Vegas police: Man steals Uber Eats car, drives impaired, 'intentionally' collides with boat
